cases.case: no GPU or failed GPU smoke
cases.expected: AUTO selects the qualified CPU; CPU itself must remain qualified.
cases.observed: Runtime selection used CPU and exposed no fallback when GPU was unavailable or failed smoke.

cases.expected: Reject the stale GPU profile rather than remapping it by gpu:0.
cases.observed: The registry rejected driver drift and bound current ephemeral index mapping to the stable device identity.

cases.expected: Reject a profile whose measured peak crosses the conservative memory safety line.
cases.observed: The registry rejected the injected unsafe peak-memory report.

cases.case: GPU worker failure on the second ticket image
cases.expected: Keep globally reusable committed GPU work for other jobs, discard the affected waybill GPU generation, and rerun both waybill images on CPU.
cases.observed: The affected waybill obtained two CPU artifacts, the committed first GPU artifact remained reusable, and no mixed-runtime waybill result was accepted.

cases.expected: Emit one technical error and terminate the worker so unknown device state is never reused.
cases.observed: The worker returned exit code 43 after the first failed command and did not process the second command.

cases.case: pause, cancel, and stale lease during OCR
cases.expected: Finish the current image quantum, persist the safe checkpoint, release the lease, and fence stale results.
cases.observed: Pause resumed without redownload, cancel waited for the image boundary, and a stale lease could not commit.

cases.expected: Fail as a system error and never create a finance-review business item.
cases.observed: The job failed technically and no human-review outcome was created.

cases.expected: Windows-owned OCR child exits without attaching to or terminating unrelated processes.
cases.observed: The owned NDJSON worker stopped after the synthetic parent crash.

cases.case: candidate bootstrap or later worker handshake failure
cases.expected: Keep the previous active composition and close every worker already started for the failed attempt.
cases.observed: The active pointer remained unchanged after candidate smoke failure, and a later CPU handshake failure closed the previously started GPU worker.
